title: EmployeeSnapshot
description: data of workforce.employee.created.v1 and workforce.employee.updated.v1 (full snapshot). Never contains passwords or salary. Deletion is workforce.employee.deleted.v1 with a tombstone.

employmentStatus.description: e.g. ACTIVE, INACTIVE. Identity disables login for anything other than ACTIVE.

jobRoleIds.description: Currently valid job roles. Scheduling keeps a local copy to check qualifications without calling Workforce. Changes to employee job roles publish workforce.employee.updated.v1.
